description: This file implements the WSEndpoint class template for WebSocket server/client endpoints, including connection management, message handling, event loop control, and template instantiations for various configurations.

classes.name: WSEndpoint
classes.description: A template class implementing WebSocket endpoint functionality, including connection management, message handling, event loop control, and configuration for different roles, messaging interfaces, ping-pong mechanisms, and encryption methods.

methods.name: WSEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebSocket endpoint, setting up logging, channels, handlers, and starting the event loop.

methods.name: ~WSEndpoint
methods.description: Destructor stopping the event loop, closing connections, and cleaning up.

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes the current WebSocket connection if it is open.

methods.name: startEventLoop
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket event loop in a separate thread.

methods.name: stopEventLoop
methods.description: Stops the WebSocket event loop thread if it is running.

methods.name: registerHandlers
methods.description: Registers message, open, close, and fail handlers for WebSocket events.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket connection if it is open.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, filtering by opcode and passing payload to the messaging interface.

methods.name: onOpen
methods.description: Handles new connection establishment, initializes connection handler, and starts ping mechanism.

methods.name: onFail
methods.description: Handles connection failure, logs error details, and updates authentication state.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the connection object from a connection handler.
